rate_authorities.nuclear: canonical-air number density times option4 G4GammaConversion/G4BetheHeitler5DModel total per-atom cross section minus G4BoldyshevTripletModel per-atom cross section
rate_authorities.triplet: canonical-air number density times G4BoldyshevTripletModel per-atom cross section with G4EMLOW7.13 livermore/tripdata

source_energy_contract.authoritative_kinetic_energy_definition: Geant4 total energy minus the lepton particle-definition PDG rest energy or the exact BH5D target nuclear rest energy; this avoids high-gamma dynamic-mass cancellation in GetKineticEnergy
source_energy_contract.four_energy_validation: sum(Geant4 secondary total energies) - (incident photon energy + BH5D target rest energy); the residual is recorded as provenance because the pinned model projection is not 64-epsilon exact
source_energy_contract.geant4_raw_kinetic_energy_role: provenance only; GetKineticEnergy uses a reconstructed dynamic mass and is not the authoritative high-energy kinetic projection
source_energy_contract.local_booking_policy: book the exact nonnegative post-normalization remainder as target recoil/binding energy
source_energy_contract.normalization_policy: if the fixed-mass local remainder is negative within the derived projection tolerance, multiply every nonnegative lepton kinetic energy by available/sum; otherwise retain the Geant4 lepton energies
source_energy_contract.projection_arithmetic_tolerance_definiti: 64 * binary64 epsilon * max(available energy, initial total energy, final total energy)
source_energy_contract.projection_mass_offset_definition: 2 * (510998.95 eV - Geant4 electron/positron PDG rest energy)
source_energy_contract.projection_tolerance_definition: abs(BH5D four-energy residual + projection mass offset) + projection arithmetic tolerance
source_energy_contract.raw_all_secondary_residual_definition: sum(all fixed-PDG-mass secondary kinetic energies) - available_energy_eV
source_energy_contract.source_identity_validation: fixed-mass residual equals BH5D four-energy residual plus the schema-vs-Geant4 lepton-mass offset, and raw GetKineticEnergy residual additionally equals the summed dynamic-mass defect; both identities are checked at 64 binary64 epsilons

target_selector_contract.probability_definition: normalize the four channel-specific C/N/O/Ar rate weights once per energy/topology task, then draw one target with G4UniformRand

rate_authorities.nuclear: canonical-air number density times max(option4 per-atom total conversion cross section - G4BoldyshevTripletModel per-atom cross section, 0)
rate_authorities.triplet: canonical-air number density times G4BoldyshevTripletModel per-atom cross section

target_selector_contract.rejected_legacy_policy: drawing target Z from the unsplit option4 total-conversion rate for both conditional channels
target_selector_contract.statistics_tolerance_definition: for every task and Z, abs(observed - N*p) <= max(10, 6*sqrt(N*p*(1-p)), 0.005*N)

threshold_policy: analytic zero-phase-space endpoint; no empirical record
